questions.question:
What will come in place of the question mark (?) in the following equation, if '+' and '−' are interchanged and '×' and '÷' are interchanged?

69 − 36 × 6 ÷ 12 + 5 = ?
questions.solution:
BODMAS Rule:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/952c967501c582f1911db7fefdaaefa9b6e3f505512624eb925e04e002be5a1f.png] 

Given equation : 69 − 36 × 6 ÷ 12 + 5 = ?

Now if '+' and '−' are interchanged and '×' and '÷' are interchanged then:

⇒ 69 + __**36 ÷ 6**__ × 12 - 5 

⇒ 69 + __**6 × 12**__ - 5 

⇒ __**69 + 72**__ - 5 

⇒ 136

Hence, the correct answer is *'*Option 2'.

questions.question: A, B, C, D, E and F are sitting around a circular table facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order). F sits third to the left of A. D sits to the immediate left of A. C sits second to the right of A. Only E sits between A and C. When counted from right of A, who sits to the immediate left of B?
questions.solution:
Given:

A, B, C, D, E and F are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

1) F sits third to the left of A.

2) D sits to the immediate left of A.

3) C sits second to the right of A. Only E sits between A and C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2099e14f44175332e84ac58da0c5cf339351448413a435ff1d3de4f72d05cb88.png] 

So, 'F' sits to the immediate left of B.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option (3)".**

questions.question: P, Q, R, S, T and U are sitting around a circular table facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order). R is sitting to the immediate left of P and immediate right of T. Q is sitting to the immediate left of T. U is sitting to the immediate left of Q. P is sitting to the immediate left of S. Who is sitting to the immediate right of S?
questions.solution:
Given:

P, Q, R, S, T and U are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

1) R is sitting to the immediate left of P and immediate right of T.

2) Q is sitting to the immediate left of T.

3) U is sitting to the immediate left of Q.

4) P is sitting to the immediate left of S.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/522cccc797565be02df3f39d25e52017f80490627df5e21664611e5e75cf1daa.png] 

So, 'U' is sitting to the immediate right of S.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (3)".

questions.question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following sets.

(NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into their constituent digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding/subtracting/multiplying to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)

(34, 22, 63)

(61, 76, 144)
questions.solution:
The logid follows here:

**(1st number + 2nd number) + 7 = 3rd number.**

Given:

(34, 22, 63)

⇒ (34 + 22) + 7 = 56 + 7 = 63 = 3rd number

And,

(61, 76, 144)

⇒ (61 + 76) + 7 = 137 + 7 = 144 = 3rd number

Similarly, In Option (2): (45, 41, 93)

⇒ (45 + 41) + 7 = 86 + 7 = 93 = 3rd number

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option (2)".**

questions.question:
What will come in the place of '?' in the following equation if '+' and '×' are interchanged and '−' and '÷' are interchanged?

100 − 4 ÷ 7 + 5 × 12 = ?
questions.solution:
BODMAS Rule:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/952c967501c582f1911db7fefdaaefa9b6e3f505512624eb925e04e002be5a1f.png] 

Given equation : 100 − 4 ÷ 7 + 5 × 12 = ?

Now if '+' and '×' are interchanged and '−' and '÷' are interchanged then:

⇒ __**100 ÷ 4**__ − 7 × 5 + 12

⇒ 25 − __**7 × 5**__ + 12

⇒ 25 − __**35 + 12**__

⇒ __**37**____** − 35**__

⇒ 2

Hence, the correct answer is *'*Option 1'
